decisions.reason: Close to the established core, the option remains cheap to keep and its value is still likely to be realized.
Building on established construction offerings, it carries low uncertainty and remains a valuable option.
Distant from the core and without positive results after two years, its option value is unlikely to justify further resource use.
Close to the core and supported by a large rental order, the option shows realized value and low uncertainty.
Despite being distant, the demonstrated 1,000 operating hours and ore moved reduce uncertainty enough to keep the option open.
